content: अजिरः {%a.%} [अज् गतौ किरन् वीभावाभावः <ls>Uṇ. 1. 53.</ls>] Quick, swift (शीघ्र) .{@-रः@} .²1 A sort of mouse, hairy mole. .²2 A kind of ceremony in pronouncing curses .{@-रम्@} .²1 A court-yard, an enclosed space, arena; उटजाजिरप्रकीर्ण <ls>K. 39</ls>, आस्थाननिकेतनाजिरम् <ls>Ki. 1. 16</ls>; so रण˚ सावित्र इति विख्यातः प्रविवेश रणाजिरम् <ls>Rām. 7. 27. 34</ls> गृह˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 The body. .²3 Any object of sense. .²4 The wind, air. .²5 A frog. .{@-रा@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a river. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .{@-रः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a snake-priest.
